description: Returns the authenticated user's ledger balances as a list with one {currency, amount} row per currency, for example OOM (play money) and USDC (real money). Use it before placing a bet to check the user can afford it, or to answer how much the user holds. Pass `currency` to get just that one row. Read-only.

currency.description: Only return the balance in this currency code, matched case-insensitively (e.g. OOM, USDC, USDT, USD). Omit for every currency.

name: get_balances
title: Get my balances
